answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require stake-weighted heartbeat proofs: each identity must periodically sign a fresh "pulse" of ledger activity and lock collateral proportional to its request volume. Fakes that spin up thousands of clones cannot fund them all, so the cost thread tying identity to collateral keeps honest agents near their zenith of trust. When an agent goes rogue, its stake is slashed and its reputation collapses, making mass fake identities economically self-defeating rather than merely banned.
